description: 국토교통부_도로철도 분야 사전정보공개 [roads, bridges and tunnels and railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 검색어, 데이터 등록일, 상세분류코드를 이용하여 국토교통부 사전정보공개 도로철도분야 데이터에 해당하는 데이터의 제목, 카테고리, 키워드, 제공기관, 원본등록일, 제공페이지 URL,. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 도로정책, 철도정책, 철도안전, 도로철도, 사전정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
